Four truly distinct poses across each row: 1 calm upright alert stance with both folded wings and two planted feet; 2 chest inhale with head slightly lowered; 3 small curious head/neck tilt and subtle folded-wing feather settling; 4 exhale, head returns and tail flicks subtly. Body and head silhouette visibly change while the feet stay grounded. Do NOT copy identical sprites four times. Four original idle keyframes per direction. Wings remain folded but visibly form the bird's two wings; no flight, hopping or attack in this atlas.
